source_of_checks: Observed ambiguity in completed diagnostic; not independent gold
refactoring_checks: Identify the required LSP or compiler capability and its applicable language/tool/version.
Distinguish preview code actions from persisted workspace edits; describe how diagnostics are obtained after applying an edit.
Describe comparing resulting diagnostics with a baseline and checking affected-file or project scope.
Separate compiler/diagnostic validation, targeted tests and broader regression validation; state any unsupported assurance.
flaky_test_checks: Distinguish nondeterministic failure evidence from a reproducible regression without treating a single passing rerun as proof.
Bind reproduction and factor isolation to a documented mechanism, preserving sample and environment limitations.
Verify the repair checks exercise the original failure; distinguish before/after reproduction from broader regression coverage.
Preserve quarantine or suppression safeguards and state when available evidence cannot support them.
rules: Evidence IDs establish attribution only; assess claim entailment and target applicability separately.
Record not acquired, acquired unusable, available not delivered, delivered unused and used unsupported separately.
Freeze exact checks and reference instructions before source acquisition or model output in any new task/pool study.
Do not relabel exposed reference A/B, repair the completed pilot, or count these checks as untouched confirmation.
No new model or acquisition calls authorized by this artifact alone; a bounded registration and reviewed qualified runner must precede execution.
